answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and hence a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in marble and timber recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 6 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the lotus. A 366 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
